items.subject: Application | Inclusion Coordinator | Amer AlSaaideh
items.htmlBody:
Dear Learning Center Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, an inclusive education coordinator and special education teacher with over five years in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools and special education work in Qatar. I hold an MA in Special Education (Excellent). The Learning Center is part of Qatar Foundation Pre-University Education and provides support services to students in QF schools.

  • Achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities for the first time in a government school.
  • Delivered special education courses in the Higher Diploma for Teacher Preparation at Yarmouk University, and supervised the field training of pre-service special education teachers.

I am applying for an Inclusion Coordinator or Learning Support Specialist role. My CV is attached.

Kind regards,

Amer Abdeljalil AlSaaideh
Special Education Specialist | Inclusive Education Coordinator
MA in Special Education (Excellent) | 5+ years in Jordan and Qatar

items.subject: Application | Inclusion and Learning Support | Amer AlSaaideh
items.htmlBody:
Dear Hamilton International School Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, an inclusive education coordinator and special education teacher with over five years in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools. I hold an MA in Special Education (Excellent). The school has an inclusion and learning support team that works with teachers and families on individual education plans (IEPs) where needed.

  • Achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities for the first time in a government school.
  • Managed an IEP and a teaching plan for each student, built on formal and informal assessments.

I am applying for an Inclusion Coordinator or Learning Support Teacher role. My CV is attached.

Kind regards,
